name: Delay time

every.note: adjacent enemies lose their last action per holder (peer.mjs planning)

text: All affected adjacent enemies perform one less action per round until someone destroys the effect. At first contact enemies still finish their current action; enemies perform at least one action per round.

ui.perm_help: Delay Time — each adjacent enemy loses the last action of every turn per holder next to them

resources.match_reason: slow faint rings for slowed time

effect.path: assets/Sprites/Effects/Effects1/Spell effect faint rings/Spell effect faint rings - idle [EZ14].png
effect.usage: effect animation strip (cols = frames; grid in assets/frames.json), play once at the target hex

spell.usage: WBC3 spell-cast sound paired with the EZ effect; play when the effect is cast

fx.usage: sound effect on resolution / impact of the effect

data.text: All affected adjacent enemies perform one less action per round until someone destroys the effect. At first contact enemies still finish their current action; enemies perform at least one action per round.

logic.description: Implemented (2026-10-29). While the permanent stands, each adjacent enemy loses the last action of every turn per holder adjacent to them (two holders leave only the first action). Judged at planning, so the action in progress at first contact still completes; at least one action per turn remains.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Actions an adjacent enemy loses per turn: one per adjacent Delay Time holder, at most actions_per_round − 1.
Rule 12: the permanent is placed with a point-buy die (re-rolled until the sum fits); that die is its power under Rule 24.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys this permanent when it is at least the token value behind the cast element.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_time (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
